sources.note: Halo.Bungie.Org's original Halo Cutscene Library lists Final Credits (2:56). Primary transcription was verified against the locally supplied original Xbox credits.bik; this public page supplies a reviewable credits-video reference.
Original Xbox manual, printed page 27 (PDF page 15). Halopedia archives Bungie's xbox_manual.pdf. Used to cross-check the movie and preserve explicitly labeled manual-only credits.
Secondary in-game credits transcript. Useful for role order, but contains spelling differences and omits Personal Thanks; the original movie takes precedence.

provenance.scope: Original English Xbox Halo: Combat Evolved credits only. No PC, Mac, Gearbox, Anniversary, or Master Chief Collection credits are imported.
provenance.verification: Visually decoded the original local Bink movie at five-second intervals with overlapping credit text, and compared the original Xbox manual. No proprietary movie or manual assets are bundled.

original_movie.note: English original Xbox end-credit movie; the source/interface/attract_mode.c game_end_credits_start function plays this movie.

provenance.role_policy: Original movie role groups and order are preserved. The movie's long audio role title is preserved, voice character attributions are stored below, and manual supplements follow the movie credits with Xbox Manual prefixes.
provenance.name_policy: Preserve names exactly as displayed in the original movie, including its spellings; use straight apostrophes and ASCII hyphens for the original game font. Repeated names in different roles are intentional. Published credits are the scope, rather than a claim to identify every uncredited contributor.
discrepancies: The movie spells Stephen Okasaki, Paul Russel, and Brian Schultz. Halopedia's transcript spells Stephan Okasaki, Paul Russel, and Brian Shultz; movie spellings are retained.

The movie spells Paul Pedersen, Zach Russell, and Matthew Shimabuku. The manual prints Paul Peterson, Zach Russell, and Mathew Shimbaku; Halopedia's transcript spells Paul Pederson, Zach Russel, and Matthew Shimabuku. The movie's names are retained rather than treating variants as extra people.

The movie spells Tawnya Pettiford-Waites, Ken Boynton, Andrew McKaige, and Juan Ramirez. The manual prints Keny Boynton and Andy Mckaige; Halopedia's transcript uses Tanya Pettiford-Wates and Juan Remirez. Original movie spellings are retained.
The manual includes Justin Hayward under Draft Dodgers and David Dunn under Multiplayer Artists; those appear as labeled supplemental roles.
The manual places Brian Morden in Special Thanks; the movie credits him under Additional Voices. The movie placement is retained.
The manual calls Additional Voices Bungie Folks, while the movie says And the Bungie Auxiliary Players. The movie collective credit is retained.
The movie has fourteen Testers, including Jeff Kafer and Todd Schultz; the manual lists twelve. Both movie-only testers are included.
The movie credits Keith Steury separately as User Testing Lead; the manual includes him under Test Leads. The movie grouping is retained.
The manual credits Karin Jaques as Designer; the movie credits her as Print Artist. The movie attribution is retained.

Personal Thanks differs between sources: the movie uses Alex - Laura, John F. - Kate, M&D, the girls, Chris B. - Jody, Brooklyn, and Paul P. - Laura Drevecky. The manual prints Alex - Laura Seropian, Jeffrey - Kate, M&D, the girls, Chris B. - Jody, Maxwell, and Paul B. - Laura Drevecky, and includes Outsiders - thx 4M*!PIA!. Distinct manual names or attributions are preserved in the labeled supplement without inferring alias identities.
The movie adds P. Bertone - Family, Marta & Max and B. Wallace - Milo, Castle Argh to Personal Thanks; those movie lines are included.
The original Bink Video (c)1997-2001 by RAD Game Tools, Inc. notice is an engine vendor attribution rather than a named-person role; its text is preserved as vendor_credit below.
